paragraphs.text: Umezawa's Jitte ( oo-meh-ZAH-wahz JEE-tay ), later potentially known as the Lost Jitte , is a legendary artifact jitte originally wielded by Toshiro Umezawa .

Umezawa's Jitte - a specialized small-bladed weapon - is the one that Toshiro Umezawa wielded throughout his entire life - from his early years to his exile from Kamigawa to Dominaria. Toshiro was a famous samurai during the Kami War of Kamigawa who was transported to Dominaria by the Myojin of Night's Reach and later founded Clan Umezawa . The Jitte likely crossed the planes with him. It or a very similar Jitte known as the Lost Jitte was contained in Maag Taranau and later released on Thunder Junction .
